law: A role-channel claim is decided by mutating the channel on documentElement and reading getComputedStyle before/after/after-restore — never by grepping a stylesheet for the channel name. A gradient claim is decided by reading the surface (own background + both pseudo-elements) AND every visible descendant (own background + both pseudo-elements) — never by reading only the surface node's own backgroundImage. A shadow-typed-channel claim is decided by diffing the box-shadow LAYER LIST before/after mutation — never by predicting or substring-matching the browser's serialization of an injected value. A run's VALIDITY is decided by hashing source, generated and served CSS before and after — never by assuming a run that took a few minutes sampled one consistent state.
